test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Gandhi's ways of life, if followed in their entirety, will aid us in the creation of a society of peace and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**harmony**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**harmony**" means a state of peaceful existence and agreement. (सामंजस्य)
 
• Following Gandhi's ways of life can help in creating a society where people live in peace and harmony.
 
• The other options: "**cacophony**", "**agitation**", and "**discord**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Gandhi's ways of life, if followed in their entirety, will aid us in the creation of a society of peace and harmony__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cacophony (कर्कश ध्वनि)**: means a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.
 
• **Agitation (उत्तेजना)**: means a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.
 
• **Discord (कलह)**: means disagreement between people.
